turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Hi there. It's Doctor Smith from Babylon. Can you confirm your name, date of birth, and your home address, please?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, it's [inaudible] .

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: [inaudible] . Um, I can't hear you at the moment actually. Could you turn it up, the, volume up?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, can you hear me better now?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: [inaudible] . Yeah, that's better. Thank you.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, OK. Sorry about that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Are you in a private place you can have a consultation?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What can I do for you today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I've been having this, blinding headache for a few days. Um, and it's like, really bothering me and [inaudible] , I find it very hard to focus or, like I can't even go to work.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and any headaches in the past before this?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not really just they're, on and off. Um, I recently had a, a one for like two days, um, but it just went away with Ibuprofen, so nothing like, more, longer than two days before.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So, how did this start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, it just started all of a sudden. I woke up one morning with a headache, and that was three days ago, and I just keep having it. Doesn't really go away with Ibuprofen either, I try that, but it just. It gets a little bit better but like, doesn't go away.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and whereabouts in your head is the pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, it's kind of all over but, I feel like over my right eye, it's um bit, stronger.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any problems with your vision? Or, any problems tolerating the light?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, lights definitely make me more sensitive. Like, um, I don't really, like strong lights. Um, and um, yeah, vision I think, I get this, shooting light sometimes. Um, not sure how to explain it. Just a bit of um, weird kind of vision.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and um, any, any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, feeling a bit sick, but no vomiting.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any tingling? Or numbness? Or weakness anywhere?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any change in your smell or taste?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, none at all.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, and, in the past, when you've had headaches, what have they been like?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I was sick but I had no more headache, it's just um, a bit of a pressure, in between my eyes, um. But nothing major.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and, with, with this, has it been there all the time? Or is it coming and going?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Kinda all the time. Um, so when I take Ibuprofen it gets a bit better, so it's a bit, like less um, it, it bothered me less, but then I still have it, it's still there.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, and what would you say, the severity is? If, if ten is the worst pain you've ever had, and zero is nothing, what would you say the pain is like?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I guess it's mostly, eight, and then it kinda comes down to maybe a five.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and what about at night-time, are you able to fall asleep?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, I'm, sleeping well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Is it waking you up in the night-time?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, no. But I can wake up with it in the morning.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any worse when you change position, or bend over, or cough, or anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Mmm. Sometimes when I stand up, quickly I get a bit of a, stabbing pain. Um, or if I throw my head like, it I kind of feel like something is moving inside.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you had any, uh, eye checks recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, actually had one recently and, nothing changed my vision.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you had any cold symptoms, sore throat, sore ears, or pain over the sinuses? Any cough or flem?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No. Any, any nose bleeds, or coughing up any blood or anything?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And just recently, have you been well, or have you had any general problems? Any change in your weight? Or, tiredness, lack of energy, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no change of weight, maybe um, lack of energy but it might be because, I'm just having these headaches. so I'm find it quite difficult to go through my daily activities [inaudible] , you know when you have this constant headache.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you been at work recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I work from home but, couldn't really manage to, do it all the time. So sometimes I just took a day off.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So, you've been, you've had a headache for three days. [inaudible] , how many days have you missed off work?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, so I worked from home all these three days and, um. First day I worked from home and then, um, the second I just took the whole day off. And, today I just tried to work from home the first half of the day but, I, I just stopped in the morning 'cause, I couldn't focus.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And, any other, medical problems in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I think I only had a, a [inaudible] pain, um, when I was younger but, no causes found and that went away, but that's, the only thing I know of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Have you been abroad recently at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you take any medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, just the pill.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Which one?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, [inaudible] .

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And when did you start that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, about a year ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any side effects with that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you noticed any, any um, increased frequency of headaches since you started that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no, [inaudible] , these headaches just very recently, but nothing um, [inaudible] but nothing really changes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And when you'd [inaudible] , when you've had, when you described your headaches in the past, you said they were just general. Did you have any visual symptoms? Flashing lights? Nausea, vomiting with them?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No. No, no. No nothing, none of those.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had your blood pressure checked recently with your pill?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, I had it checked in the pharmacy when I got the pill, and they say it was normal.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And when was that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, a year ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Um, and any allergies to anything?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And who do you live with at home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sorry?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Who do you live with at home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, just by myself.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you smoke?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you drink any alcohol regularly?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How much in a normal week do you think?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, probably like, three [inaudible] , once a week.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: [inaudible] . OK. And do you take any other drugs at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no apart from the Ibuprofen that I take, sometimes when, the headache [inaudible] gets really bad, nothing else.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Um. So, uh, I mean it's obviously the first time you've had such a bad headache. And you said you'd had some altered light in front of your eyes as well?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: But you haven't had a high temperature. Have you checked your temperature?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no I didn't, I don't really feel, feverish or anything.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Um, I mean it, it, it could possibly be a migraine type headache. But, the fact it's still ongoing for three days, we probably should, book you into an appointment to get an examination. Um, obviously [inaudible] , if it settles, in the meantime then, we can cancel that. But we should do a neurological examination, look at the back of your eyes as well.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, in terms of medication, I can prescribe you something, similar to Ibuprofen, but a bit stronger which you can take instead of Ibuprofen. And you can also take Paracetamol at the same time.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So if you're happy to book a, [inaudible] , appointment with us, with the support line, for us to do a full examination. And start, the medication which I prescribe to you, take it with food. If, if you're, you said that when you go to bed your headache's, OK, and not waking you up in the night-time.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah it's not, um but, you mentioned migraine and that um, reminded that, my mum, suffers from, like she has migraines, um.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any other family history of medical problems?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no I think that's it, but I know that my mum like, she has quite bad migraines, she's like, has the vomiting and everything, [inaudible] .

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK that's fine. Um, I mean if, if in the meantime before your appointment your, headache is getting unbearable, getting worse or changing. Then [inaudible] , um, if it's that bad, then you should go to A and E and have an examination. Um, [inaudible] , you can call us for further advice on that.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK. Mm-hmm, OK.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And when, when you have a, an examination with us, we'll check your blood pressure as well. Just to, make sure your pill's still appropriate for you, because sometimes if we, if we do think it's a migraine, then you would have to change your pill. If you've had these flashing lights, and things like that.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK, [inaudible] . Is there anything in the pill that can cause it? Or is it?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Well [inaudible] , some [inaudible] , so that pill if you were having [inaudible] , regular migraines with um, flashing lights, or [inaudible] , other symptoms. It wouldn't be suitable to stay on that pill, particularly, we'd have to change it to something else.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: All right.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: But you can carry on with that for the moment.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you got any other questions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, so will you like, um, send me a referral to a specialist, or do I have to [inaudible] to confirm?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uh. Yeah, if you book an appointment with the support team, then we can do a full examination then.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK. Perfect.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: All right then. Take care.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Thank you very much.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Bye.
